g.text: Two independent lines of evidence: (i) canonical (rotation- and strand-normalised) SHA-256 of the two plasmid
sequences are identical (ce3adc8f…); (ii) BLASTN full-length alignment covers 128,837/128,837 bp at 100.0% identity
with 0 mismatches (128,837 bp union of two HSPs split at the circular origin; forward rotation 111,659 bp).
The plasmid is IS-rich but lacks any conjugation module (no relaxase/Mob/TraG/MPF); the bacteriocin module region
(31.1–74.7 kb, red arc) shows no IS enrichment over the plasmid average (0.32 vs 0.31 MGE per kb).
